note: Both sets correctly capture the two annotated Figure 7-3 values (∂P/∂θ at θ=0 = -25.52E+6 watt/rad and θK = 6.302336°) and the doubling relation of Eq. Set A adds four clearly misbound claims that B omits: θK restated as a generic blade-pitch angle θ, the sensitivity attributed to a "Blade-Pitch Controller" and to the axis label "Rotor-Collective Blade-Pitch" (with a truncated unit "watt/ra"), and θ = 6.302336° attributed to the controller. B's two extra claims (θK and rated sensitivity under best-fit regression) are supported and well bound, so B is the cleaner, more faithful set.
